new_candidates.body:
### Describe the bug

The MuJoCo `render_mode="human"` viewer (`WindowViewer` in `gymnasium/envs/mujoco/mujoco_rendering.py`) saves the frame captured with the `T` key ("Cap[t]ure frame") to the hardcoded path `"/tmp/frame_%07d.png"`.

On Windows, that path is relative to the root of the current drive, which normally has no `tmp` folder, so `imageio.imwrite` raises `FileNotFoundError` inside the GLFW key callback. pyGLFW re-raises a callback's exception from the next GLFW call (`glfw.poll_events()` in `WindowViewer.render`). The MuJoCo environments render inside `step()` in human mode, so the exception ends the user's `env.step()` loop. If the current drive does have a `\tmp` folder, the frame silently lands there instead of in the temporary directory.

On Linux and macOS the capture works because `/tmp` exists, but it ignores `TMPDIR` (on macOS, the per-user temporary directory).

### Code example

Run this from a directory on a drive without a `\tmp` folder (typically `C:`), then press `T` in the viewer window:

```python
import gymnasium as gym

env = gym.make("InvertedPendulum-v5", render_mode="human")
env.reset(seed=0)
for _ in range(1000):
    env.step(env.action_space.sample())
```

```
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "capture_frame_loop.py", line 12, in <module>
    env.step(env.action_space.sample())
  ...
  File "gymnasium\envs\mujoco\inverted_pendulum_v5.py", line 173, in step
    self.render()
  File "gymnasium\envs\mujoco\mujoco_env.py", line 161, in render
    return self.mujoco_renderer.render(self.render_mode)
  File "gymnasium\envs\mujoco\mujoco_rendering.py", line 795, in render
    return viewer.render()
  File "gymnasium\envs\mujoco\mujoco_rendering.py", line 493, in render
    update()
  File "gymnasium\envs\mujoco\mujoco_rendering.py", line 475, in update
    glfw.poll_events()
  File "...\site-packages\glfw\__init__.py", line 1861, in poll_events
    _glfw.glfwPollEvents()
  File "...\site-packages\glfw\__init__.py", line 692, in errcheck
  ...
  File "...\site-packages\glfw\__init__.py", line 671, in callback_wrapper
    return func(*args, **kwargs)
  File "gymnasium\envs\mujoco\mujoco_rendering.py", line 542, in _key_callback
    imageio.imwrite(self._image_path % self._image_idx, np.flipud(img))
  ...
  File "...\site-packages\imageio\core\request.py", line 418, in _parse_uri
    raise FileNotFoundError(
FileNotFoundError: [Errno 2] The directory does not exist: 'X:\\tmp'
```

In this run, the working directory was on a drive `X:` without `\tmp`, and the key press was posted to the window with `PostMessageW` (`WM_KEYDOWN`/`WM_KEYUP` for `T`).

### System info

- Gymnasium 1.4.0, installed from source (`pip install -e ".[all,testing]"`, commit c08564bb)
- Windows 11 Pro 10.0.26300
- Python 3.12.12, mujoco 3.17.0, glfw 2.11.0, imageio 2.38.1

### Additional context

`os.path.join(tempfile.gettempdir(), "frame_%07d.png")` fixes it, and it also honors `TMPDIR` on other platforms. I'll open a PR with a regression test.

### Checklist

- [x] I have checked that there is no similar [issue](https://github.com/Farama-Foundation/Gymnasium/issues) in the repo
